notes: Screen 06 is Book Step Six (Career Events, Core pp.128-131).
The book's d20 roll is not offered; the player chooses both events. Because nothing is rolled, the book's option to roll more than twice and mix the benefits is not offered either.
Prototype: the two events must be different (the book does not say).
The book's optional event traits (e.g. Inventor of X, Friend to the X) are not used.

An event's focus can be one of its book suggestions, any of the book's Sample Focuses (pp.94-95), or the player's own. Events whose suggestion names no focus (Lauded by Another Culture, Serious Injury) offer the Sample Focuses and custom only.
The book applies attribute (12) and department (5) limits at Step Seven, so no limits are checked here.
Art for each event is eventArtPattern with {id} replaced by the event id. Missing files fall back to the placeholder portrait.
